recommendation: Keep the fix as the bounded FHIR-22710 reconciliation. Handle unresolved questions from FHIR-54477/FHIR-54480, such as heading reorganization or StructureMap annotation/resource representation, only after separate work-group disposition.
issue_request: FHIR-22710 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking the mapping-language DSL to support compact identity conversion syntax such as `src -> tgt: type, subtype, action, recorded;` so unchanged fields are easy to see and differences stand out.
initial_application: Historical commit 14d597bbd5fc2322a7137393c5fb72efa365837f added the Simple Form: Identity transform narrative to source/mapping-language.html, but it only touched that HTML page and did not update the formal grammar artifact linked from the page.
additional_context: source/mapping-language.html is current mapping-language source, publish.ini includes mapping.g4, and source/fhir.ini lists StructureMap as active, so images/mapping.g4 is a current published grammar artifact. Zulip and FHIR-I minutes support the same syntax discussion. Later issues FHIR-54477 and FHIR-54480 are still Triaged and confirm the grammar/resource-representation gap, but they are not final decisions and also ask broader follow-up questions.
reconciliation: Updated images/mapping.g4 so a rule block can begin with one optional mapIdentityCopy production matching the documented `src -> tgt: ...;` identity-copy shortcut. The grammar shape preserves the documented first-entry restriction by allowing mapIdentityCopy only before ordinary mapRule entries.
source_changes: images/mapping.g4: changed mapRules to allow an optional first mapIdentityCopy and added the mapIdentityCopy production for `source -> target: property, property;` syntax.
